   A record roll call was requested.

   On the question “Shall the motion to concur be adopted? (S.F. 603),
the vote was:
Yeas, 32:

Alons            Bousselot        Campbell        Costello
Dawson           De Witt          Dickey          Driscoll
Evans            Garrett          Green           Gruenhagen
Guth             Klimesh          Koelker         Kraayenbrink
Lofgren          Reichman         Rowley          Rozenboom
Salmon           Schultz          Shipley         Sinclair
Sires            Sweeney          Taylor          Warme
Webster          Westrich         Whitver         Zumbach

Nays, 15:

Bennett          Bisignano        Blake           Donahue
Dotzler          Knox             McClintock      Pike
Quirmbach        Staed            Townsend        Trone Garriott
Weiner           Winckler         Zimmer

Absent, 3:

Celsi            Petersen         Wahls

  The motion prevailed and the Senate concurred in the House
amendment.
586                     JOURNAL OF THE SENATE                       66th Day



    Senator Schultz moved that the bill, as amended by the House and
concurred in by the Senate, be read the last time now and placed upon
its passage, which motion prevailed by voice vote, and the bill was read
the last time.

   On the question “Shall the bill pass?” S.F. 603, the vote was:
Yeas, 32:

Alons            Bousselot        Campbell         Costello
Dawson           De Witt          Dickey           Driscoll
Evans            Garrett          Green            Gruenhagen
Guth             Klimesh          Koelker          Kraayenbrink
Lofgren          Reichman         Rowley           Rozenboom
Salmon           Schultz          Shipley          Sinclair
Sires            Sweeney          Taylor           Warme
Webster          Westrich         Whitver          Zumbach

Nays, 15:

Bennett          Bisignano        Blake            Donahue
Dotzler          Knox             McClintock       Pike
Quirmbach        Staed            Townsend         Trone Garriott
Weiner           Winckler         Zimmer

Absent, 3:

Celsi            Petersen         Wahls

  The bill, having received a constitutional majority, was declared to
have passed the Senate and the title, as amended, was agreed to.

                    IMMEDIATELY MESSAGED

  Senator Whitver asked and received unanimous consent that
Senate File 603 be immediately messaged to the House.

                             ADJOURNMENT

  On motion of Senator Whitver, the Senate adjourned at 3:16 p.m.
until 9:00 a.m., Thursday, March 20, 2025.
